item.tib: stag la kho na snying khu'i rgyud las ma mo bon skyong bsgrubs pa
item.coloph: ces pa 'di ni ston pa stag la me 'bar gyis phung bon mgo dmar la rgyud (brgyud) cing dar nub skabs su/ res shig nub ste/ slar yang ma 'ongs dus su kho bo dbra rigs g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal bdag gis/ me rta zla tshes la/ gyim shod ri bo'i nub phyogs su bgyis pa dge 'o//
